standard.summary: 控制 torch.compile 处理输入形状的方式：auto（自动）/ token_flatten（序列展平，适合 native token bucket）/ fixed_pad（固定填充）。
standard.effect: token_flatten 在 Anima/Newbie native token bucket 路线下将变长序列展平，减少形状变化导致的重编译；非 native DiT 自动 fallback 到 fixed_pad。
standard.whenToUse: Anima LoRA 长训练推荐 token_flatten + compile_cache 组合。
standard.avoidWhen: 使用非 native DiT 路线（如 SDXL）时 token_flatten 会自动 fallback，保持 auto 即可。

optionDescriptions.fixed_pad: pad 到固定形状，少重编，可能多算废 padding。
optionDescriptions.token_flatten: token 展平，动态维少一点，native bucket 友好。
optionDescriptions.native: 走模型自己的 shape 约定。

standard_en.summary: How torch.compile handles input shapes: auto / token_flatten (sequence flattening, suited to native token buckets) / fixed_pad (fixed padding).
standard_en.effect: On the Anima/Newbie native token bucket route, token_flatten flattens variable-length sequences to cut recompilation caused by shape changes; a non-native DiT falls back to fixed_pad automatically.
standard_en.whenToUse: For long Anima LoRA runs, token_flatten plus compile_cache is the recommended combination.
standard_en.avoidWhen: On a non-native DiT route (SDXL, say) token_flatten falls back anyway, so leaving it on auto is fine.

optionDescriptions.fixed_pad: Pads to a fixed shape: less recompilation, possibly wasted work on the padding.
optionDescriptions.token_flatten: Flattens tokens, leaving fewer dynamic dimensions; friendly to native buckets.
optionDescriptions.native: Follows the model's own shape conventions.

advanced.principle: token_flatten 将 [B, H, W, C] 或 [B, T, C] 展平为 [B×T, C]，确保序列维度合并后形状稳定，减少 Dynamo guard 触发重编译。
advanced.tradeoffs: token_flatten 需要模型支持展平后的输入形状，不兼容的层会自动回退。

advanced_en.principle: token_flatten flattens [B, H, W, C] or [B, T, C] into [B×T, C], ensuring stable shapes after sequence-dimension merging and reducing Dynamo-guard recompiles.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: token_flatten requires the model to accept the flattened input shape; incompatible layers fall back automatically.
